title: "Hi, I'm Andrea Vasquez"

<img src="images/headshot.jpg" style="width:30%; border-radius:50%">

I'm a second-year MPH student in the Department of Epidemiology at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health.

My work focuses on infectious disease surveillance and cancer epidemiology. I'm currently a data analyst at the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, where I work with tick-borne disease surveillance data, and a teaching assistant in the Department of Epidemiology at Mailman. My thesis looks at second primary cancers in early-onset cancer cases using SEER data.

Take a look at my [resume](resume.html), or find me on [GitHub](https://github.com/adv2123).
